reason: The nomination reads the original-signature capacity pathway without its shared semantic limits. The complete object already excludes more occurrences scored with the same unvalidated DRY/MOIST labels and requires an independent dry-referent binding for physical dryness. A changed eligible occurrence may alter capacity for a declared signature comparison without establishing the historical dry-source meaning. Do not harden every structural replay into a semantic prerequisite or count a wording change as a new research decision.

operative_reopening.criteria_origin: Prospective reviewer proposal, not historical preregistration or rerun permission. Alternative pathways below are not cumulative requirements.
not_sufficient: More occurrences scored using the same unvalidated DRY/MOIST and preparation glosses.
The report PASS/validator checks or chosen renderer wording.
Optical p/pulvis resemblance or exporting free substring meanings.

requirements: Identify genuinely changed evidence or a different declared falsifier addressing the chosen referent/relation question.
Specify the new question’s own adequate provenance, capacity and comparison design before use; this review does not impose the old GDT769 signature or ablation model on every new test.
pathways.scope: A new claim/test may differ from the old signature model; its success does not retroactively validate the historical dry-source assignment.

pathways.applies_only_if: The proposed action reuses GDT769’s authored signature comparison.
requirements: Identify the changed independently supported donor/relation or new eligible occurrence that bears on its missing signature.
Retain the chosen original exactness, provenance, support and strongest-locus exclusion contract; any alteration must be declared as a different test, not silently counted as the old gate passing.
Explain why the tested I11 dry-powder or I12 residue signature actually addresses the particular dry-source commitment under consideration.

operative_reopening.question: What, if anything, independently binds the pcheey field to a physically dry referent and to an input/source, output/result or separate-item relation? A record-field organization is compatible with a source referent; specify which additional commitments would make concrete alternatives distinguishable.
shared_limits: State which complete whole or exact span and historical/new model version is being tested before consulting fresh target evidence.
For a physical dryness claim, require an independent binding to the relevant referent’s dry property; moisture of an adjacent item alone is neither that binding nor a refutation.
Do not treat input/source, output/result and record organization as necessarily exclusive labels. Freeze observable contrasting commitments only where the proposed hypotheses actually differ.

evidence_use: Both file hashes match, but neither quoted text equals the declared source span. They are not accepted as exact source evidence. Root decision rests on the complete operative reopening object.
scope: One nominated dossier adjudicated; the peer lexical screen is not a primary audit of all107 dossiers. No dossier revision, rank change, readiness change or meaning.
